text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One afternoon—I spotted Neo Universe 
acting rather suspiciously.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
! ...Trainer... Neo Universe requests 
"silence."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Mission, "Phase B." The requirements are 
"Confidentiality" and "Observation."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction she was gazing— 
Oguri Cap was there.
Could she be secretly 
observing her...?
choice_data_list: Why would you do that all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Reception"—Neo Universe is 'a little bit 
similar' to Oguri Cap. "THRF"—first, 
perform "Observation."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In other words... you somehow "received a 
transmission" that you and Oguri Cap are 
similar,
and you want to investigate it... 
is that it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Choosing to observe rather than directly 
interact to get to know someone... It's 
very like her, or perhaps just clumsy."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
choice_data_list: (...I think I'll keep an eye on th...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, Oguri-senpai, that's an incredible 
amount today too. It's so satisfying 
watching you eat!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Hubble"—for Neo Universe, that quantity 
is... "uncontrollable."
choice_data_list: True, you really don't eat similar...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Nice weather... I think I'll bask in the 
sun for a bit.
choice_data_list: True, your appetites are nothing a...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Bzz-bz-bzzt!)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah, this tree looks nice.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...? Significance of "tree climbing," 
unknown... Weather is "clear," yet not 
"communicating" with the cosmos... Isn't 
that a "loss"...?
choice_data_list:
Looks like Oguri spends her time 
...

Looks like Oguri spends her time 
...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hmph—!
choice_data_list: Looks like Oguri spends her time d...
Looks like Oguri spends her time d...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
“Observed” a “crater” in the turf. 
Confirmed power of “footstrike”...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Mmh. Worn down again, I see... I'll 
have to replace it.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"ASEM"...
The intensity of horseshoe wear, 
behavior—
The similarities to Neo Universe 
are "void."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Was this a 'reception' error...? No, 
but..."
—Hey, you two.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Did you want to use the track, perhaps? 
My apologies, I didn't realize I was 
hogging it..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—! A "Big Bang"... but denied. Is this... 
an interruption of "observation"...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She seems confused by this unexpected 
turn of events. However, this might be... 
a chance for even further observation!"
choice_data_list: If you don't mind, could you pace ...
If you don't mind, would you run a...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah! In that case, we can split the course 
in half. If you're fine with that, I'd 
gladly take you up on it.
choice_data_list: If you don't mind, could you run a...
If you're up for it, could you run...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
……"Observation" can be continued……? 
Perhaps even "communication"……

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Affirmative. Neo Universe wants to 
'train together' with Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe had taken the lead early on, 
but was overtaken in the middle stages. 
Oguri Cap truly is a powerhouse...!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —Hmph!!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—Kh! The "degenerate star" is still... a 
ways off, so... "Meissa" exists—!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Haaah――!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
! Impressive... But this is where it 
really begins!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...Not yet... not yet...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe clung on tenaciously. They 
contested fiercely right down to the wire 
before the finish line—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The result was a victory for Oguri Cap. 
However... Neo Universe had displayed 
incredible fighting spirit as well. And 
above all—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Contact"—"Phase C." The similarities 
are...—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Running style" and "strategy," both 
"void." And... that "feeling" is 
"altruism." Different from Neo Universe...
choice_data_list: Welcome back. You two were both so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I started to say that their competitive 
spirit was similar— but hesitated.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pointing out what she's desperately
trying 
to analyze in her own way would 
be—tactless. For now, I'll stick to just 
giving advice.
choice_data_list: That was a powerful run, Oguri!
That was a powerful run, Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pointing out what she's desperately
trying 
to analyze in her own way would 
be—tactless. For now, I'll stick to just 
giving advice.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. Consistent with Neo 
Universe's "observations."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
“However... the meaning of ‘similar’ is 
still unknown. Must ‘communicate’ more...”

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
""REQU"... Oguri Cap. Retry of "Phase 
D"..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe wants to "run alongside" 
more……

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Run together more...? Ah, of course! 
Let's do it plenty."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the two of them did as much 
tandem training as they pleased— and were 
able to "communicate" a whole lot.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Flyby...
I want to "search" for the "North 
Star." Because it should... have a 
meaning...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Are you going to keep running like
this? I 
was thinking of doing some tire-pulling, 
but... would that get in your way if 
you're running?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...! Revision is not recommended. Since 
"observation" will stagnate, please 
"accompany"...
choice_data_list: Umm... so, can we do it together?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ah, of course.
choice_data_list: Uhm... so, can I join in?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that,
we continued training together 
for the sake of "observation"...
and I was 
simply awestruck by the sheer grit of 
those two.
